summary_1line: Sugriva recounts Bali’s immense strength and past feats, including killing the demon Dundubhi, to question whether Rama can truly defeat him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bali seizes the gigantic buffalo-demon Dundubhi by the horns and hurls the massive corpse far across the forest.
Blood from the hurled corpse rains through the air and splashes into the quiet hermitage of the sage Matanga.
The titan Dundubhi, in the form of a thundercloud-dark buffalo, smashes through the gates of Kishkindha while trees splinter around him.
